name: Kubelka-Munk Theory
definition: A model for light transport in scattering media that accounts for both absorption and scattering, solving the problem of computing reflectance and transmittance for homogeneous and inhomogeneous layers where simple extinction (Lambert-Bouguer) is insufficient.
summary: Kubelka-Munk Theory is a spectral optical model for light transport in scattering media that computes reflectance and transmittance by restricting light to two opposing fluxes along a single axis.
